entries.review: Independent T2 Japanese-source review of the original high-score record UI. Preserve numeric argument order, score points, floor/depths, HP/level/strength, EXP/gold, adventure count and hours/minutes. Native writer confirms record+10 is maxHP, +12 adventure count, +18 maxstrength and +19 level. White labels/cyan values are retained. Compact English removes Japanese fixed padding while preserving the three original summary columns and all window geometry.
